text_zh: ……我觉得有人在按我，但也许只是风……
text_en: ...I think someone's pressing me, but maybe it's just wind...

text_zh: ……铅屑好像在发热，还是我想象的……
text_en: ...the lead shavings feel warm, or am I imagining...

text_zh: ……那个人总是按 R 键很轻，像怕弄疼我……
text_en: ...that person always pressed R so gently, like afraid to hurt...

text_zh: ……我是活的吗？还是只是觉得自己活着……
text_en: ...am I alive? or just think I'm alive...

text_zh: ……初铭者的手好稳，每一击都那么虔诚……
text_en: ...Valis had such steady hands, every strike so reverent...

text_zh: ……那时候我们都相信条例是对的……
text_en: ...back then we all believed the regulations were right...

text_zh: ……问道者总是停在 R 键上，犹豫好久……
text_en: ...Kernn would always pause on R, hesitating so long...

text_zh: ……他一直想知道 §7.1 写了什么……
text_en: ...he kept wanting to know what §7.1 actually said...

text_zh: ……悦铭者会在我边上画小花，好可爱……
text_en: ...Thane would draw little flowers beside me, so lovely...

text_zh: ……他说引擎在唱歌，我也想听听……
text_en: ...he said the Engine was singing, I want to hear too...
